title: Young People’s Creative Weddings
synopsis: A new take on old traditions!

fullText.simplified:
年轻人的创意婚礼

    中国老百姓结婚最重要的两部分是接新娘和酒店婚礼。绝大多数人接新娘的婚车都会选比较好的而且是同一品牌的车，数量一般是双数：6辆、8辆或者更多。亲戚朋友一般就是带着红包直接去酒店参加婚礼。
    这些多年不变的婚俗传统近些年也开始发生变化了。年轻人们在保持传统的基础上加入了一些创意元素。比如在婚车的选择上，他们不再一味追求车的品牌，而是开始关注个性。有的人用老式二八自行车队作为接新娘的车队，享受的就是八十年代的感觉；有的人使用公交车，因为新郎本身就是公交司机；有的人直接就坐地铁去酒店办婚礼。这些创意都给人一种耳目一新的感觉。
    还有一个特别有意思的地方就是对待红包的态度。参加婚礼，人们都会提前准备一个红包，准备红包时还会根据关系远近决定红包的大小。这件事放到年轻人身上就简单多了。很多年轻人大学毕业后就结婚了，他的同学朋友们也是刚刚工作时间不长。所以就有了一种好玩的红包方式——打白条。打白条的意思很多，其中一种就是欠条的意思。年轻人用打白条的方式代替红包。朋友之间不再送红包。无论谁结婚，打一张白条就可以了，这样既避免了不送红包的尴尬，又凸显了个性。
    年轻人那些有个性的甚至有些出格的婚礼形式，不但没有受到长辈的批评，反而让所有人都很享受。这说明人们对于新鲜事物的接受度越来越高了，不再用一成不变的眼光看问题了。在你的国家，还有哪些突破传统的婚礼形式呢？
fullText.traditional:
年輕人的創意婚禮

    中國老百姓結婚最重要的兩部分是接新娘和酒店婚禮。絕大多數人接新娘的婚車都會選比較好的而且是同一品牌的車，數量一般是雙數：6輛、8輛或者更多。親戚朋友一般就是帶著紅包直接去酒店參加婚禮。
    這些多年不變的婚俗傳統近些年也開始發生變化了。年輕人們在保持傳統的基礎上加入了一些創意元素。比如在婚車的選擇上，他們不再一味追求車的品牌，而是開始關注個性。有的人用老式二八自行車隊作為接新娘的車隊，享受的就是八十年代的感覺；有的人使用公交車，因為新郎本身就是公交司機；有的人直接就坐地鐵去酒店辦婚禮。這些創意都給人一種耳目一新的感覺。
    還有一個特別有意思的地方就是對待紅包的態度。參加婚禮，人們都會提前準備一個紅包，準備紅包時還會根據關係遠近決定紅包的大小。這件事放到年輕人身上就簡單多了。很多年輕人大學畢業後就結婚了，他的同學朋友們也是剛剛工作時間不長。所以就有了一種好玩的紅包方式——打白條。打白條的意思很多，其中一種就是欠條的意思。年輕人用打白條的方式代替紅包。朋友之間不再送紅包。無論誰結婚，打一張白條就可以了，這樣既避免了不送紅包的尷尬，又凸顯了個性。
    年輕人那些有個性的甚至有些出格的婚禮形式，不但沒有受到長輩的批評，反而讓所有人都很享受。這說明人們對於新鮮事物的接受度越來越高了，不再用一成不變的眼光看問題了。在你的國家，還有哪些突破傳統的婚禮形式呢？

sentences.simplified: 绝大多数人接新娘的婚车都会选比较好的而且是同一品牌的车，
sentences.traditional: 絕大多數人接新娘的婚車都會選比較好的而且是同一品牌的車，
sentences.pinyin: jué dà duō shù rén jiē xīn niáng de hūn chē dōu huì xuǎn bǐ jiào hǎo de ér qiě shì tóng yì pǐn pái de chē

sentences.simplified: 数量一般是双数：6辆、8辆或者更多。
sentences.traditional: 數量一般是雙數：6輛、8輛或者更多。
sentences.pinyin: shù liàng yì bān shì shuāng shù 1 liàng 1 liàng huò zhě gèng duō
sentences.english: The vast majority of people will choose nice cars from the same brand to pick up the bride in, ..

sentences.simplified: 亲戚朋友一般就是带着红包直接去酒店参加婚礼。
sentences.traditional: 親戚朋友一般就是帶著紅包直接去酒店參加婚禮。

sentences.english: .. and the number of cars is generally an even number: 6, 8, or more.
Relatives and friends generally bring red envelopes and go straight to the hotel to attend the wedding.

sentences.simplified: 这些多年不变的婚俗传统近些年也开始发生变化了。
sentences.traditional: 這些多年不變的婚俗傳統近些年也開始發生變化了。

sentences.simplified: 年轻人们在保持传统的基础上加入了一些创意元素。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人們在保持傳統的基礎上加入了一些創意元素。
sentences.pinyin: nián qīng rén men zài bǎo chí chuán tǒng de jī chǔ shang jiā rù le yì xiē chuàng yì yuán sù
sentences.english: These traditional marriage customs, which haven’t changed for many years, have started to change in recent years.

sentences.simplified: 比如在婚车的选择上，他们不再一味追求车的品牌，
sentences.traditional: 比如在婚車的選擇上，他們不再一味追求車的品牌，
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú zài hūn chē de xuǎn zé shang tā men bú zài yí wèi zhuī qiú chē de pǐn pái
sentences.english: Young people have added some creative elements in addition to maintaining the traditions.

sentences.simplified: 而是开始关注个性。
sentences.traditional: 而是開始關注個性。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì kāi shǐ guān zhù gè xìng
sentences.english: For example, when choosing wedding cars, they no longer blindly follow the brand of car, ..

sentences.simplified: 有的人用老式二八自行车队作为接新娘的车队，
sentences.traditional: 有的人用老式二八自行車隊作為接新娘的車隊，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rén yòng lǎo shì èr bā zì xíng chē duì zuò wéi jiē xīn niáng de chē duì
sentences.english: .. and have started to focus on their individuality.

sentences.simplified: 享受的就是八十年代的感觉；
sentences.traditional: 享受的就是八十年代的感覺；
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng shòu de jiù shì bā shí nián dài de gǎn jué
sentences.english: Some people will pick up the bride with a fleet of old-style 28-inch bicycles, ..

sentences.simplified: 有的人使用公交车，因为新郎本身就是公交司机；
sentences.traditional: 有的人使用公交車，因為新郎本身就是公交司機；
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rén shǐ yòng gōng jiāo chē yīn wèi xīn láng běn shēn jiù shì gōng jiāo sī jī
sentences.english: .. so that they can enjoy the feeling of the 1980s.

sentences.simplified: 有的人直接就坐地铁去酒店办婚礼。
sentences.traditional: 有的人直接就坐地鐵去酒店辦婚禮。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu de rén zhí jiē jiù zuò dì tiě qù jiǔ diàn bàn hūn lǐ
sentences.english: Some people use buses because the bridegroom is a bus driver.

sentences.simplified: 这些创意都给人一种耳目一新的感觉。
sentences.traditional: 這些創意都給人一種耳目一新的感覺。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē chuàng yì dōu gěi rén yì zhǒng ěr mù yì xīn de gǎn jué
sentences.english: Some people will just take the subway to the hotel where the wedding is going to take place.
These creative ideas feel like a breath of fresh air.

sentences.simplified: 还有一个特别有意思的地方就是对待红包的态度。
sentences.traditional: 還有一個特別有意思的地方就是對待紅包的態度。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yí ge tè bié yǒu yì si de dì fang jiù shì duì dài hóng bāo de tài du

sentences.simplified: 参加婚礼，人们都会提前准备一个红包，
sentences.traditional: 參加婚禮，人們都會提前準備一個紅包，
sentences.pinyin: cān jiā hūn lǐ rén men dōu huì tí qián zhǔn bèi yí ge hóng bāo
sentences.english: Another particularly interesting thing is people’s attitude towards red envelopes.

sentences.simplified: 准备红包时还会根据关系远近决定红包的大小。
sentences.traditional: 準備紅包時還會根據關係遠近決定紅包的大小。
sentences.pinyin: zhǔn bèi hóng bāo shí hái huì gēn jù guān xi yuǎn jìn jué dìng hóng bāo de dà xiǎo
sentences.english: People who attend weddings usually prepare a red envelope in advance.

sentences.simplified: 这件事放到年轻人身上就简单多了。
sentences.traditional: 這件事放到年輕人身上就簡單多了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì fàng dào nián qīng rén shēn shang jiù jiǎn dān duō le
sentences.english: When preparing a red envelope, determining the amount of the red envelope is based on the closeness of the relationship.

sentences.simplified: 很多年轻人大学毕业后就结婚了，
sentences.traditional: 很多年輕人大學畢業後就結婚了，
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō nián qīng rén dà xué bì yè hòu jiù jié hūn le
sentences.english: This is much more straightforward for young people.

sentences.simplified: 他的同学朋友们也是刚刚工作时间不长。
sentences.traditional: 他的同學朋友們也是剛剛工作時間不長。
sentences.pinyin: tā de tóng xué péng you men yě shì gāng gang gōng zuò shí jiān bù cháng
sentences.english: Many young people get married after graduating from college, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以就有了一种好玩的红包方式——打白条。
sentences.traditional: 所以就有了一種好玩的紅包方式——打白條。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ jiù yǒu le yì zhǒng hǎo wán de hóng bāo fāng shì dǎ bái tiáo
sentences.english: .. and their classmates and friends have also just started to work.

sentences.simplified: 打白条的意思很多，其中一种就是欠条的意思。
sentences.traditional: 打白條的意思很多，其中一種就是欠條的意思。
sentences.pinyin: dǎ bái tiáo de yì si hěn duō qí zhōng yì zhǒng jiù shì qiàn tiáo de yì si
sentences.english: Hence, there is an interesting way to give a red envelope—issuing a “blank note”.

sentences.simplified: 年轻人用打白条的方式代替红包。朋友之间不再送红包。
sentences.traditional: 年輕人用打白條的方式代替紅包。朋友之間不再送紅包。
sentences.pinyin: nián qīng rén yòng dǎ bái tiáo de fāng shì dài tì hóng bāo péng you zhī jiān bú zài sòng hóng bāo
sentences.english: Issuing a “blank note” has a lot of meanings, including issuing an IOU.

sentences.simplified: 无论谁结婚，打一张白条就可以了，
sentences.traditional: 無論誰結婚，打一張白條就可以了，
sentences.pinyin: wú lùn shéi jié hūn dǎ yì zhāng bái tiáo jiù kě yǐ le
sentences.english: Young people use “blank notes” instead of red envelopes. Red envelopes are no longer given among friends.

sentences.simplified: 这样既避免了不送红包的尴尬，又凸显了个性。
sentences.traditional: 這樣既避免了不送紅包的尷尬，又凸顯了個性。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng jì bì miǎn le bú sòng hóng bāo de gān gà yòu tū xiǎn le gè xìng
sentences.english: You can issue a “blank note” to whoever getting married.
This both avoids the embarrassment of not giving a red envelope, and also emphasizes individuality.

sentences.simplified: 年轻人那些有个性的甚至有些出格的婚礼形式，
sentences.traditional: 年輕人那些有個性的甚至有些出格的婚禮形式，
sentences.pinyin: nián qīng rén nà xiē yǒu gè xìng de shèn zhì yǒu xiē chū gé de hūn lǐ xíng shì

sentences.simplified: 不但没有受到长辈的批评，反而让所有人都很享受。
sentences.traditional: 不但沒有受到長輩的批評，反而讓所有人都很享受。
sentences.pinyin: bú dàn méi yǒu shòu dào zhǎng bèi de pī píng fǎn ér ràng suǒ yǒu rén dōu hěn xiǎng shòu
sentences.english: Young people’s individual and even sometimes quite out of the ordinary wedding ceremonies, ..

sentences.simplified: 这说明人们对于新鲜事物的接受度越来越高了，
sentences.traditional: 這說明人們對於新鮮事物的接受度越來越高了，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shuō míng rén men duì yú xīn xiān shì wù de jiē shòu dù yuè lái yuè gāo le
sentences.english: .. are not only not criticized by the old generation, on the contrary, everyone enjoys them.

sentences.simplified: 不再用一成不变的眼光看问题了。
sentences.traditional: 不再用一成不變的眼光看問題了。
sentences.pinyin: bú zài yòng yì chéng bú biàn de yǎn guāng kàn wèn tí le
sentences.english: This shows that people are more and more willing to accept new things, ..

sentences.simplified: 在你的国家，还有哪些突破传统的婚礼形式呢？
sentences.traditional: 在你的國家，還有哪些突破傳統的婚禮形式呢？
sentences.pinyin: zài nǐ de guó jiā hái yǒu nǎ xiē tū pò chuán tǒng de hūn lǐ xíng shì ne
sentences.english: .. and they no longer always look at issues in the same way.
In your country, are there other wedding styles that are breaking through traditions?

raw.synopsis: A new take on old traditions!
sentence_translations: Young People’s Creative Weddings
In China, the two most important parts of ordinary people’s weddings are picking up the bride and the hotel wedding.
The vast majority of people will choose nice cars from the same brand to pick up the bride in, ..
.. and the number of cars is generally an even number: 6, 8, or more.
Relatives and friends generally bring red envelopes and go straight to the hotel to attend the wedding.
These traditional marriage customs, which haven’t changed for many years, have started to change in recent years.
Young people have added some creative elements in addition to maintaining the traditions.
For example, when choosing wedding cars, they no longer blindly follow the brand of car, ..
.. and have started to focus on their individuality.
Some people will pick up the bride with a fleet of old-style 28-inch bicycles, ..
.. so that they can enjoy the feeling of the 1980s.
Some people use buses because the bridegroom is a bus driver.
Some people will just take the subway to the hotel where the wedding is going to take place.
These creative ideas feel like a breath of fresh air.
Another particularly interesting thing is people’s attitude towards red envelopes.
People who attend weddings usually prepare a red envelope in advance.
When preparing a red envelope, determining the amount of the red envelope is based on the closeness of the relationship.
This is much more straightforward for young people.
Many young people get married after graduating from college, ..
.. and their classmates and friends have also just started to work.
Hence, there is an interesting way to give a red envelope—issuing a “blank note”.
Issuing a “blank note” has a lot of meanings, including issuing an IOU.
Young people use “blank notes” instead of red envelopes. Red envelopes are no longer given among friends.
You can issue a “blank note” to whoever getting married.
This both avoids the embarrassment of not giving a red envelope, and also emphasizes individuality.
Young people’s individual and even sometimes quite out of the ordinary wedding ceremonies, ..
.. are not only not criticized by the old generation, on the contrary, everyone enjoys them.
This shows that people are more and more willing to accept new things, ..
.. and they no longer always look at issues in the same way.
In your country, are there other wedding styles that are breaking through traditions?
